create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
get_and_set_graph_weights: get arc weights as a list or numpy array and set new weights on a GTN graph
compare_graphs_for_equality_and_isomorph: compare two GTN graphs for exact equality or structural isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
run_differentiable_scalar_graph_operatio: run negate, add, and subtract on scalar graphs with autograd support via gtn.backward
run_parallel_graph_operations_on_batches: run parallel negate, add, concat, and remove operations on lists of GTN graphs
